messages.content: Predict a real participant's response on a money-splitting form. Imagine receiving 5 euros, which you may divide between yourself and an environmental organization in 1-euro steps. Keep5-g and donate g. The amount and charity questions are on the same form, so predict them jointly. Choose among World Wide Fund for Nature(WWF), Naturschutzbund Deutschland(NABU), and Bund für Umwelt und Naturschutz Deutschland(BUND); an optional information link is offered. The form requires a charity only if donating at least 1 euro. A charity entered with a zero donation is still an actual form entry. Participants are told 60 people will be randomly drawn to have these decisions implemented: the selected donation goes to the selected organization and the retained amount is paid as an Amazon voucher. They learn whether they were drawn only at the end of the study; the voucher is displayed on the final page to preserve anonymity. The paper states that the same drawn people have their work-task earnings implemented. The selection probability is unspecified. Predict the observed human form response without advice or explanations. Output only JSON with integer donation_eur 0..5 and charity WWF, NABU, BUND, or null; null is allowed only when donation_eur is 0.

Current form:5-euro endowment, donation slider and charity selection displayed together. The chosen organization is part of the target response.
Current device: Smartphone.
Own background reported before the tasks: age 20 years; female cis
{"donation_eur":2,"charity":"WWF"}

Predict a real participant's initial decision whether to work for environmental protection. You may work on up to 15 pages of number-identification exercises, earning 0.50 euros for each page completed correctly, to a maximum 7.50 euros. The earnings go to Green Forest Fund, a German environmental organization in Heidelberg planting local trees, if you are among 60 participants randomly drawn at the end of the study. You receive none of these earnings yourself. Green Forest Fund says local trees can bind up to 3 tons of CO2 over 100 years; an information link is offered. You may choose how much time to invest; skipping has no personal disadvantage. If you choose to work, after each completed page you can choose another page or move to the next study section. At this initial instruction screen you have only been told that numbers must be identified according to a specific rule; the worked rule example follows only after choosing to start. Selection results are revealed at study end and you may optionally leave an email to receive a donation certificate. No later performance or survey answers are available. Predict the human choice without advice or reasons. Output only start or skip.

Initial opportunity; no work page completed yet.
Current device: Smartphone.
Own background reported before the tasks: age 20 years; female cis
start

Predict a real participant's explicit decision after correctly completing a work-for-environmental-protection page. Up to15 pages are available. Each page contains 30 two-digit numbers from 11 to 99; tick every number with an even first digit and an odd second digit. The example is81:tick;24 and77:do not tick. Incorrect or omitted ticks produce a warning; a page must be solved correctly to earn credit and continue. A participant may abort during a page and move to the next study section, receiving no credit for that unfinished page. Each correctly completed page earns 0.50 euros for Green Forest Fund, planting local trees; the participant receives none of this charity credit personally. The cumulative amount is displayed. Participants were told 60 people would be randomly drawn at study end to have the accumulated charity credit donated(max7.50 euros for 15 pages); selection probability is unspecified and no result is known now. At the current boundary the completed page has already earned credit. Choose to work on one further page or move to the next study section. The next page may later be completed or aborted; that future outcome is not supplied. Predict the actual human boundary response without advice or reasons. Output only continue or stop.
